canada.title: Immigrants in Canada more likely to be overqualified for their jobs: report
canada.summary: A new report says too many newcomers to Canada are getting stuck in jobs they are overqualified to do, undermining the federal government’s quest to recruit highly educated, highly specialized workers from abroad.

canada.title: Steinbach software developer uses AI to help people make voting choices, follow local government
canada.summary: A software developer in Steinbach has developed a website that uses AI to comb through online local government sources to help himself, and others, make voting decisions. But some raise concerns about AI's role in the democratic process.

canada.title: Selkirk volunteer hopes federal funds for homelessness make their way to Manitoba city
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced $1 billion in funding to tackle homelessness while in Winnipeg earlier this month. Volunteers are hoping a fair chunk of that money will flow to other Manitoba communities.

canada.title: Troubled northeast London apartment building without heat as winter weather arrives
canada.summary: As the city marked its first snowfall of the season on Tuesday, tenants of a northeast London high-rise beset with managerial and maintenance issues were going another day without heat.

canada.title: Witnesses, video reveal details of police response that ended with man’s death
canada.summary: Some residents of Murray Avenue in Fredericton are questioning how a response by police to a disturbance complaint ended with a neighbour's home going up in flames and the neighbour dying.

canada.title: 'It's my dream': Sussex parents eager for francophone school to be built
canada.summary: Some parents living in Sussex say a francophone school the province plans to build in the area is highly-anticipated and will help solidify the presence of a growing community of French speakers in the area.

canada.title: She grew up in group homes. Now she’s piecing together her past
canada.summary: Marisa Wright, 37, is trying to piece together her broken childhood through school, police and government records. Some agencies initially supplied only a limited amount of information in a few summary pages and others denied access completely.

canada.title: Couple shocked to find their fixer-upper demolished
canada.summary: A bungalow nestled on the outskirts of Springhill, N.S., was a pandemic purchase for a couple, but they were surprised to return this fall to find all buildings and irreplaceable mementoes on the property gone.

canada.title: Nihtat Gwich'in Council takes municipality, territorial gov't to court over Inuvik community plan
canada.summary: The designated Gwich'in organization based in Inuvik said the Town of Inuvik failed to properly consult and respect treaty rights when developing and approving its community plan.

canada.title: Residents fight to save the last store on Change Islands
canada.summary: With the only grocery store and gas station in Change Islands slated to shut down, some residents in the small central Newfoundland outport community are banding together to create a co-operative and save the community’s lifeline.

canada.title: $65k in donations? That's a lot of bones for a Happy Valley-Goose Bay shelter
canada.summary: The annual holiday fundraising drive for the SPCA in Happy Valley-Goose Bay has started off with a bang following tens of thousands in donations from anonymous animal lovers.
